title: Phase 0 → Phase 1 contract
description: What Phase 0 (FOUNDATION) guarantees to every Phase 1 lane. Phase 1 MUST NOT start until a document validating against this schema exists and every boolean is true. These are the guarantees that let eight lanes edit the same repo without fighting.

baselineCommit.description: Commit every lane worktree branches from. Recorded so a lane that drifts can be diagnosed.

checkHarnessSplit.description: server/check-api.js is 3375 lines and every lane wants to append to it. That is the single worst merge conflict in this plan. Phase 0 converts it into an append-only manifest.

existingSuitesRegistered.description: All 15 existing harnesses reachable from the manifest. 13 of 15 were previously unreachable from any package manager.

skipFailsUnderCI.description: check-api.js:211-214 and check-migrate.js:24-25 print SKIP and exit 0 with no database. Correct on a laptop, dangerous in CI: a misconfigured DATABASE_URL goes green having asserted nothing.

verified.description: Proven by running with the env var set and no database reachable, and observing a non-zero exit.

dbGuardPorted.description: check-api.js:45 defaults DATABASE_URL with no loopback check, no host= query check, no PGHOST check, no DB-name check. Pointed at production it CREATE SCHEMAs on the live payroll database. demo/db-guard.mjs already defeats all four and proves it in 16 cases.

verified.description: Proven by pointing DATABASE_URL at a non-loopback host and observing a refusal.

migrationNumbersReserved.description: Migration numbers are a hard serialization point: two lanes both writing 006_*.sql collide unrecoverably. They are assigned here, up front, and no lane may choose its own.

kind.description: expand = additive, safe against old code, may run before restart. contract = destructive, only after restart.
